name: SHFE natural rubber
notes: Delivers domestic whole-field latex SCR WF and imported RSS3, duty and VAT paid. Lists 10 months (no Feb, no Dec). name: INE TSR 20 rubber
notes: BONDED delivery: the price carries no import duty and no VAT (vat_rate 0), unlike SHFE:RU. Lists every month; main is 1-3 months out and rolls monthly. bbg_root is a PLACEHOLDER.

name: SHFE bleached softwood kraft pulp
notes: NBSK. Lists all 12 months, hence depth 10 for calendars alone: first candidate to cut to depth 6 with rule adjacent. No liquid offshore paper pulp leg exists (NOREXECO is dormant). foreign_access confidence: low. bbg_root is a PLACEHOLDER.

name: Bursa Malaysia crude palm oil
notes: Global palm benchmark, physically delivered, MYR. The benchmark is the THIRD month; the spot month expires on the 15th. Depth 7 so the DCE:P main month (up to 6 months out) is covered. bbg_root KO best guess.

name: Bursa Malaysia DCE soybean oil (USD)
notes: Listed Mar 2024, cash settled in USD against the DCE:Y settlement price. An access proxy for DCE:Y, not an independent price; almost no open interest. Lot size confidence: low. bbg_root is a PLACEHOLDER.

name: SGX SICOM TSR 20 rubber
notes: International TSR 20 benchmark, quoted in US cents per kg (price_scale 0.01). Liquidity sits 2-5 months out. Depth 6 covers the SHFE:RU main-month anchor. bbg_root OR best guess.

name: OSE (ex-TOCOM) RSS3 rubber
notes: Moved from TOCOM to OSE in July 2020. Liquidity sits in the FAR (5th-6th) month, so tenor main is the 6th generic: depth 6. bbg_root JN best guess.

name: CBOT soybeans
notes: Quoted in US cents per 60 lb bushel (price_scale 0.01). Bloomberg root is the single letter S (ticker 'S 1 Comdty', with a space): the puller must pad one-letter roots. Depth 7 tracks July-November a year ahead. July = old crop, November = new crop.

name: CBOT soybean meal
notes: 48% protein, USD per SHORT ton. No November contract: November beans pair with December products. bbg_root SM.

name: CBOT soybean oil
notes: Quoted in US cents per lb (price_scale 0.01). Since 2021 driven by renewable diesel and the RVO as much as by food demand. bbg_root BO.

name: CBOT corn
notes: US cents per 56 lb bushel. One-letter Bloomberg root ('C 1 Comdty'). July = old crop, December = new crop.

name: CBOT soft red winter wheat
notes: US cents per 60 lb bushel. One-letter Bloomberg root ('W 1 Comdty'). July is the first new-crop month for winter wheat. Variable storage rates cap the carry.

name: CBOT KC hard red winter wheat
notes: The Kansas City Board of Trade was bought by CME in 2012 and the contract is a CBOT product since 2013. bbg_root KW.

name: MIAX Futures (ex-MGEX) hard red spring wheat
notes: MGEX was renamed MIAX Futures in 2024 and moved HRS wheat off CME Globex to its own platform in mid-2025: check that Bloomberg still carries MW and that volume survived. confidence: low on current liquidity.

name: CME lean hogs
notes: Cash settled on the CME Lean Hog Index (CARCASS weight). Quoted in US cents per lb, which is numerically USD per cwt, so quote_unit USD/cwt with price_scale 1. bbg_root LH.

name: CME live cattle
notes: Physically delivered fed steers, about 1250-1400 lb. Cents per lb = USD per cwt. bbg_root LC.

name: CME feeder cattle
notes: Cash settled on the CME Feeder Cattle Index (700-899 lb steers). Moves inversely to corn. bbg_root FC.

name: ICE cotton No.2
notes: US cents per lb. October is thin. July = old crop, December = new crop.

name: ICE sugar No.11 (raw)
notes: Raw cane sugar FOB, US cents per lb. March-May is the end of the northern crop against the start of the Centre-South Brazil crush.

name: ICE coffee C (arabica)
notes: Washed arabica, US cents per lb.

name: ICE New York cocoa
notes: USD per tonne. Open interest has shrunk a lot since the 2024 squeeze and margin increases.

name: ICE canola

name: ICE London white sugar No.5

name: ICE London robusta coffee

name: ICE London cocoa
notes: GBP per tonne. bbg_root QC best guess.

name: Euronext (Matif) rapeseed
